description:
Decisions of one court or court family, by relevance or by date (latest
decisions: `search_recent_admin_decisions`). Keywords in French.
ECHR, CJEU: texts sometimes in English only.

Example: search_case_law(query="licenciement inaptitude", court="CASS")

Args:
    query: keywords (optional with numero_rg), plural included except "in double quotes";
        OR/AND/NOT/NEAR in UPPERCASE between two words are operators (NEAR = within
        10 words); lowercase words are plain words
    court: ADMIN (CE+CAA+TA, default) | CE | CAA | TA | ARIANEWEB | JUDICIAIRE | CASS | CA | TJ | TCOM | CONSTIT | CEDH | CJUE | CNDA
    court_name: "TA Lille", "CAA Douai" (ADMIN, CE, CAA, TA)
    sort: relevance | date_desc | date_asc (ADMIN, CE, CAA, TA, CNDA)
    date_min: YYYY-MM-DD (not ARIANEWEB, CEDH, CJUE)
    date_max: same
    numero_rg: RG number (CA, JUDICIAIRE)
    nature: QPC, DC… (CONSTIT)
    limit: per page (max 50)
    offset: pagination (pass next_offset as is)
